provenance.source: JPL Horizons fixed 2026-09-03 epoch. Uses the published model-derived ecliptic pole (longitude 228°, latitude 39°), converted using J2000 mean obliquity 23.439291111°; J2000 is assumed because the paper does not specify equinox. The 59°/121° aspect ambiguity and unquoted pole uncertainty remain; prime meridian and rotational phase are arbitrary.
provenance.qualification: Computed 2003 VS2 Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose.
